title: Bound a binary Frobenius fixed space independently of field degree
statement: For invertible T over F_(2^d), F2-independent solutions of u^[2]=T*u are F_(2^d)-independent. Hence binary kernel dimension kappa<=m for m field coordinates.

requires: An actual invertible m by m field matrix T and coordinatewise Frobenius
Exact binary kernel of the declared equation
provides: For invertible T over F_(2^d), F2-independent solutions of u^[2]=T*u are F_(2^d)-independent. Hence binary kernel dimension kappa<=m for m field coordinates.
assumptions: This controls dimension, not a generic small kernel or polynomial enumeration at growing m
costs: Binary linear algebra on md coordinates; streaming2^kappa kernel combinations remains charged
contract.units: Original independent Boolean bits; F_(2^d) elements and ordinary field/ring exponents are distinct from Boolean ANF masks. Exact signed/zero counts and source-local phase/rank/depth units.
contract.obstruction: Do not replace enumeration of all kernel combinations by a chosen basis, or infer kappa=0.

body: A minimal field dependence is normalized, squared and multiplied by T^-1. Subtraction removes its first coefficient, so minimality forces every remaining coefficient into F2, contradicting binary independence. This is the actual source proof.
